items.headline: Sesko recovery progressing ahead of new season
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko is progressing well in his recovery, according to club updates shared a day ago.

items.headline: Mbeumo scores twice in Atletico Madrid victory
items.summary: Bryan Mbeumo scored 2 goals as Manchester United defeated Atletico Madrid 2-1 in pre-season competition.

items.headline: JJ Gabriel makes Manchester United debut vs Atletico Madrid
items.summary: Young player JJ Gabriel made his competitive debut for Manchester United, impressing in final minutes.

items.headline: Yoro to play more minutes at right-back position
items.summary: Michael Carrick indicated Leny Yoro will feature more at right-back following Atletico Madrid performance.

items.headline: Rasmus Hojlund completes permanent move to Napoli
items.summary: Hojlund departed Manchester United permanently to join Napoli in summer 2026 transfer window.

items.headline: Youri Tielemans signed on five-year deal from Aston Villa
items.summary: Manchester United activated release clause to sign midfielder Tielemans from Aston Villa on five-year contract.
